definitions.normal: Raw Havok event normal (on these surfaces points into the other body); top contact has ny approximately -1.
definitions.incoming: Projectile linear velocity before the 1/120 s solver step of first callback.
definitions.outgoing: Projectile velocity after the final callback step in a contiguous contact episode, before session terminal handling.
definitions.time: Session elapsed at callback; solver interval ends 1/120 s later.
definitions.freeFlightSincePrior: First callback time minus previous episode final callback time. Discrete solver timing, not analytic intersection time.
definitions.meshes: World runtime counts only; no launcher, scenery, camera or HUD. Mock shadow registrations, not rendered draw calls.
